positive: A rendered interface needs WCAG 2.2 AA repair findings verified by keyboard, browser, or measurement.
negative: The request is only cognitive load or multilingual expansion without an accessibility defect.

exclusions: Do not self-attest a fix without browser or source evidence.
Do not treat an automated audit as complete coverage.

outputs.primary: prioritized WCAG repair ledger with measured verification

stop_conditions: Stop when the user path or target artifact is unavailable.
Stop when a finding needs cognitive or locale expertise rather than a WCAG repair.
